name: South Dakota Water Feasibility Studies Act
official: South Dakota Water Feasibility Studies Act
summary: South Dakota Water Feasibility Studies Act This bill directs the Department of the Interior to study the feasibility of constructing projects to supply municipal, rural, and industrial water from the Missouri River in Iowa, Minnesota, Nebraska, and South Dakota. Specifically, the bill requires studies on projects to supply water to the (1) Western Dakota Regional Water System; (2) Lewis and Clark Regional Water System, Inc.; and (3) Dakota Mainstem Regional Water System.
